releaseNotes:
v2.27.0 — Billing diagnostics, scroll fix, timer balance & UI polish
• Billing: added setup warning banner when Play Console products are not loaded
• Billing: richer error messages showing which product failed and why
• Timer Mode: using the free definition item halves bonus time (+15s instead of +30s)
• Main menu: fixed Play/Go button text overflow on small screens
• Game grid: scroll now follows the active guess row (not the last empty slot)
